content.ledger_intro: The Radix Public Network represents a fundamental shift in how distributed ledgers are architected. Instead of forcing all transactions through a single sequential pipe, Cerberus enables infinite parallelism.
content.core_concepts_body: Every resource on Radix is a physical vault. Unlike Ethereum where tokens are just balances in a massive smart contract, on Radix, tokens are native objects understood directly by the ledger engine.
content.callout_epochs_body: Epoch transitions occur approximately every 5 minutes. During this time, the validator set is rotated based on total delegated stake. Active node runners must maintain uptime to avoid missed proposals.
content.atomic_body: When a transaction interacts with multiple decentralized applications, Cerberus braids the relevant shards together dynamically. If one step fails, the entire transaction reverts automatically without locking funds across shards.
content.validator_body: Validator nodes are responsible for proposing and voting on transaction batches within their assigned shards. Node runners must maintain high availability and stake XRD to participate.
content.cerberus_body: Cerberus is Radix's unique Byzantine Fault Tolerant consensus protocol. It achieves linear scaling by allowing shards to operate independently while coordinating only when transactions span multiple shards.
content.native_assets_body: Assets on Radix are first-class citizens of the ledger. Each resource resides in a vault that acts as a secure container. Transfer logic is built into the protocol, not external contracts.
content.resource_model_body: Radix's resource model defines how assets are created, split, and merged. Each resource has immutable metadata and behaviors defined at creation time through Scrypto blueprints.
content.cross_shard_body: Transactions spanning multiple shards are coordinated via the Cerberus braiding protocol. The ledger guarantees that either all operations confirm atomically, or none of them do.
content.braiding_body: Braiding temporarily interleaves participating shards during a cross-shard transaction. Once the transaction completes, shards resume independent operation with no additional overhead.
